steps.title: Dewax sections with hexane
steps.instruction: Place 10‑μm FFPE brain sections on glass slides, add enough hexane to cover the tissue, let the solvent remove paraffin, then air‑dry the slides at room temperature.

steps.title: Measure area and collect tissue
steps.instruction: Photograph each slide, determine the area of each section using ImageJ, then use a surgical knife to scratch six sections (total area ≈ 16 mm²) from the slide and transfer them into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add organic solvent
steps.instruction: To each 1 mm² specimen add 1 μL of 100 % DMSO, DMF, MeOH, TFE, or hexafluoro‑2‑propanol (HFIP; WAKO). Then add an additional 96 μL of the same solvent to the tube containing the six scratched sections.

steps.title: Incubate for extraction
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at 37 °C for 16 hours to solubilise amyloid fibrils.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 15,000 × g for 15 minutes, then carefully transfer the supernatant (amyloid extract) to a new tube.

steps.title: Analyze extract (optional)
steps.instruction: Subject the collected supernatant to SDS‑PAGE and mass‑spectrometry for amyloid identification.
